title: IT Integrator
full_description:
City of Taguig, Philippines
Background on what ING is about
ING Hubs Philippines (ING Hubs PH) is an international part of the ING organization delivering services to many Business Units across the world for both Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking activities. Working for ING Hubs PH means working with the most diverse workforce and where no challenge is the same.
At ING our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe that sustainable progress is driven by people with the imagination and determination to make a better future for themselves and those around them.
ING is changing what banking is. For you, that means plenty of opportunities for personal growth in a continuously evolving environment. If this is the environment you thrive in, then apply and join us in changing the future of banking!
As a Feature Engineer, you will be a key player in the cooperation between IT and Businessstakeholders. You drive to make complex changes happen within and across Tribes. Your holistic view as well as your knowledge of both Business and IT are crucial in translating business requirements into business value. You align between squads – from the same or different Tribe(s) – and other parts of the organization and manage dependencies.
Interpretation of business rules and functional and non-functional requirements to define technical specifications based on an architectural design provided in terms of interaction among systems, data exchange, transformations following a specific design methodology
Participates and cooperates in shaping activities, participates in feasibility analyses for new or upgraded initiatives (Epic and User Story) assessing the impacts for IT as well as participating and supporting developers in the development phase
Performs detailed, functional and technical analysis/design
Test support and problem determination
Collaborates in defining new suppliers and contractual requirements
Breaks down requirements and technical solution into appropriate section (User Story) examining costs, benefits and risks of various options before selecting an approach;explanation/justificationof decisions in a logical and systematic manner
KeyCapabilities/Experience
4+ years of experience in software development projects preferably in Agile methodology
Experience in designing backend solutions and developing applications with Java on/with J2EE platform, Spring, Spring Boot
Experience in designing frontend solutions using TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular and JQuery
Experience in the same role in a complex environment with 24/7 service availability
Excellent knowledge of the existing IT architecture (for the relevant domain) and technical flows
Minimum Qualifications
Problem solving skills to find creative ways of driving progress and removing impediments
Analytic skills for creating end-to-end solutions
A team player mindset, with a 'make it happen' mentality, eager to learn and the ability to coach others
Good communication skills in English, strong communication and presentation skills (telling – selling) across different skill and seniority levels
Main areas of knowledge: Microservices architecture and domain design model
Advanced experience in the development of REST & SOAP application services
Technology landscape (application level) of the relevant domain
DBMS and SQL (e.g., Oracle, PL/ SQL)
JUnit testing, test driven development and Spring integration testing
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
